url.description: Base URL of the IPAM Autopilot Cloud Run service (e.g. `https://ipam-xxx.run.app`). Can also be set via the `IPAM_URL` environment variable.

cidr.description: The allocated CIDR block (e.g. `10.0.4.0/22`). Computed on create; can be set to request a specific CIDR.

domain.description: Routing domain ID. When omitted the first routing domain is used.

labels.description: Key/value labels to attach to the range. Keys must be ≤ 63 characters, values ≤ 255 characters.

name.description: Unique name for the IP range.

parent.description: Parent CIDR block from which the range is allocated (e.g. `10.0.0.0/16`). When omitted the routing domain's root range is used.

range_size.description: Prefix length of the subnet to allocate (e.g. `22` for a `/22`). When `cidr` is set, this is derived automatically from the prefix length and can be omitted.

name.description: Human-readable name for the routing domain.

vpcs.description: List of VPC identifiers scoped to this domain. Accepts full resource URLs or short names (e.g. `my-vpc`). Used by Cloud Asset Inventory integration to avoid overlaps with existing subnets.

id.description: ID of the IP range. Use this when the range is managed in the same stack to avoid stale name lookups.

name.description: Name of the IP range to look up. Use `id` when the range is managed in the same stack.

cidr.description: The CIDR block of the range.

free_addresses.description: Number of IP addresses not yet allocated.

id.description: ID of the IP range. Use this when the range is managed in the same stack to avoid stale name lookups.

name.description: Name of the IP range to look up. Use `id` when the range is managed in the same stack.

total_addresses.description: Total number of IP addresses in the range.

used_addresses.description: Number of IP addresses allocated to direct child ranges.

utilization_pct.description: Percentage of address space allocated to direct child ranges (0-100).
